quoi: the extraction cost audit (Routing single service): the buyer measures their current document extractor and the candidates on a labelled sample of their own documents, on their own machine, and receives a sealed report of the cheapest routing that is not measurably worse, per field, with the saving at their volume
decide: prices chosen by Arslane on 2026-09-29, the grid proposed in the market note of the same day (cascade-portes/prix-marche-routing.md)
donnees: The measurement runs on your machine and offline. Only an aggregate sealed record comes to us: no document, no extracted value. Testing a cloud extractor sends pages to that vendor under your own account, as it does today; the local tiers keep every page on your machine.
frais_fournisseurs: Vendor fees for the pages you run through cloud extractors are billed to you by those vendors, on your own keys.
